verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an OpenAI-compatible chat completions base URL and says to pick a model "from our catalog," but nothing documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint or any other programmatic way to list the live catalog. The broad "drop-in OpenAI replacement" claims are framed around chat completions and are too indirect to count as documented catalog enumeration. The probes also found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt that might have exposed such an endpoint.
